title: LazyTrain: Limited-resource Allocation toward Zero-waste Yield Optimization in Large Language Model Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.11919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training large language models on limited hardware is increasingly a scheduling problem across GPU compute, host memory, PCIe transfer, and storage bandwidth. Existing offloading systems reduce GPU residency, and MegaTrain shows that a CPU-master layer-streaming executor can train large models on a single GPU, but fixed checkpointing and placement heuristics still leave communication exposed on the critical path. We propose LazyTrain, an optimization layer over a layer-streaming executor. LazyTrain formulates checkpoint selection, activation placement, recomputation, and CPU-GPU-NVMe communication overlap as a mixed-integer scheduling problem, then executes the solved policy during training. It further couples 8-bit optimizer states with fast gradient clipping as a single Hybrid 8-bit operator: state compression reduces optimizer-state memory, while fast clipping counteracts the additional CPU-side update overhead. Across H800 experiment

translated_title: LazyTrain：面向大语言模型训练零浪费产出优化的有限资源分配
translated_abstract: 在有限硬件上训练大型语言模型，日益成为涉及GPU计算、主机内存、PCIe传输和存储带宽的调度问题。现有的卸载系统减少了GPU驻留，MegaTrain表明CPU主控的层流执行器可以在单个GPU上训练大型模型，但固定的检查点和放置启发式方法仍使通信暴露在关键路径上。我们提出LazyTrain，作为层流执行器之上的优化层。LazyTrain将检查点选择、激活放置、重计算以及CPU-GPU-NVMe通信重叠形式化为一个混合整数调度问题，并在训练期间执行求解出的策略。它进一步将8位优化器状态与快速梯度裁剪耦合为单一混合8位算子：状态压缩减少了优化器状态内存，而快速裁剪抵消了额外的CPU端更新开销。在H800实验上...
tldr: LazyTrain通过将检查点、激活放置和通信重叠形式化为混合整数调度问题，并引入混合8位算子，实现了大语言模型训练中有限资源的零浪费优化。
en_tdlr: LazyTrain formulates checkpointing, activation placement, and communication overlap as a mixed-integer scheduling problem, and introduces a hybrid 8-bit operator to achieve zero-waste resource optimization in large language model training.
